entities.summary: Hassan Husni bin Saleh bin Abd al-Wahhab bin Yusuf Al-Samadhi Al-Tujibi. He was born in Tunis, on Monday 27 Ramadan 1301 AH / 21 July 1884 AD, and died there on Saturday 18 Sha’ban 1388 AH / 9 November 1968 AD. a Tunisian writer, linguist and historian, his name is compound: Hassan Husni.
